subject: StratusHealth hybrid workshop kickoff — scheduling, travel & calendar holds
messages:
From: Amanda Lopez <amanda.lopez@stratushealth.org>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Stratus Ops <ops@stratushealth.org>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: StratusHealth kickoff — hybrid workshop planning

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week — leadership liked the performance numbers and we
want to lock in a hybrid workshop the week of Dec 6 to get the pilot started.

High level: we expect ~18 people onsite in Boston (Stratus HQ) and 6 participating
remotely across EST/PST/EU timezones. Key objectives: model selection for inference,
latency targets, and rollout plan.

Can your team propose 2x 4-hour workshop windows (onsite + overlapped remote hours)
for Dec 7–9 that work for Redwood execs and our Infra/Compliance leads? Also: will
you be able to cover travel for a senior engineer and a solutions architect?

Attachments: none yet — I can share attendee list once confirmed.

Thanks,
Amanda Lopez
Head of Platform Eng, StratusHealth
Amanda.Lopez@stratushealth.org
Office: +1 617-555-0142
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Lopez <amanda.lopez@stratushealth.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: StratusHealth kickoff — hybrid workshop planning

Amanda — thanks for the note and congrats on getting leadership buy-in.

Quick answers up front: yes, we can support a hybrid format and we will plan to send
Hannah (myself) + Ben (onsite logistics lead) + Marissa (solutions lead) as the core
Redwood team. We can also bring a senior engineer if a deep-dive on kernel/quantization
is needed.

Proposed windows (please tell us which works best for your execs):
- Option A: Dec 7, 09:00–13:00 EST (overlap with PST: 06:00–10:00 PST) — good for
  East Coast majority + some early PST remote attendees.
- Option B: Dec 8, 12:00–16:00 EST (09:00–13:00 PST) — later start for East Coast,
  better for hands-on breakout sessions for US-only attendees.

On logistics we need:
- final onsite attendee list (name, title, dietary restrictions)
- confirmation of a main room with projector + mic for panel + one breakout room
- AV contact and a local network/VPN test window
- travel approvals by Nov 25 for any ticketing we book

I attached a draft agenda (agenda_v0.1.pdf) and a short travel checklist for Redwood
staff to speed approvals. Can you share the Stratus attendee list and any hard time
blocks (e.g., executives only available mornings)?

If helpful, we can post 2x tentative calendar holds (1 per option) and update once
we have a confirmed slot.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Redwood Inference | www.redwood.ai
Attachment: agenda_v0.1.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Amanda Lopez <amanda.lopez@stratushealth.org>
Date: 2026-11-17T08:45:00-05:00
Subject: Re: StratusHealth kickoff — hybrid workshop planning

Looping in some logistics context from my side. A few practical items we should
confirm before posting holds: 

1) Hotel block: I recommend we request a 3-room block for Redwood (Hannah/Ben/Marissa)
   and a 5-room block for Stratus visiting execs — will need a name + card to hold.
2) Travel: Redwood policy needs approvals by Nov 25 to use corporate travel. If
   Stratus wants us to book, we need the attendees' passport name and arrival windows.
3) AV/network: ask for a wired drop for the demo rig (we'll bring a small GPU box)
   and confirm on-site AV crew (we need a lav mic + HDMI switcher).
4) Timezones: if EU participants join, plan a short async prep doc and record one
   30-minute pre-brief to avoid late-night live sessions.

Attached: travel_checklist.xlsx (internal template) — includes corporate booking
questions and per-diem guidance.

Ben
Ben Carter
Events & Field Ops, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
Attachment: travel_checklist.xlsx
From: Amanda Lopez <amanda.lopez@stratushealth.org>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Stratus Ops <ops@stratushealth.org>, Todd Everett <todd@runway-events.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T11:20:00-05:00
Subject: Re: StratusHealth kickoff — hybrid workshop planning

Thanks, Hannah and Ben — good context. Attendee update below.

Stratus onsite attendees (Boston HQ):
- Laura Kim, VP Product
- Sameer Gupta, CTO (limited availability morning of Dec 8)
- Claire Donovan, Head of Infra
- Ops desk: ops@stratushealth.org (onsite coordination)

Remote participants: 4 engineers on PST/EU schedules — EU prefers afternoon EST.

We confirm we have a main room with AV and one breakout; Todd from Runway Events
is our external venue coordinator (looping him). Todd, can you confirm hotel block
and whether you need a credit card to hold rooms?

We prefer Option B (Dec 8, 12:00–16:00 EST) for the main workshop; Dec 7 can be a
short onboarding + pre-brief session for remote folks.

Attendee CSV attached (stratus_attendees.csv). We'll provide dietary restrictions
by Monday the 22nd.

Best,
Amanda
Attachment: stratus_attendees.csv
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Lopez <amanda.lopez@stratushealth.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Todd Everett <todd@runway-events.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T14:30:00-08:00
Subject: Confirmed: Dec 8 12:00–16:00 EST workshop + tentative holds posted

Amanda — great, thanks for the attendee list and for picking Option B.

I posted two tentative calendar holds from Redwood (we'll update once we have hotel
confirmation):
- Redwood Hold A: 2026-12-07 15:00–16:00 EST — Remote onboarding / pre-brief (30–60m)
- Redwood Hold B: 2026-12-08 12:00–16:00 EST — Main hybrid workshop (onsite Boston)

Attachments: agenda_v1.pdf (updated with breakout topics) and hotel_block_confirmation.pdf
(placeholder from Runway Events — Todd please replace with final when available).

Next asks for Stratus to confirm by Nov 25:
- final attendee dietary restrictions and any mobility/access needs
- AV contact name + a 30-minute window the week of Nov 30 for network/VPN test
- approval for Redwood to book travel for 3 team members (we'll share PNRs once booked)

We'll also prepare a 20-minute recorded pre-brief for EU participants and share the
recording link the morning of Dec 7.

Looking forward — will confirm hotel details once Todd replies.

— Hannah
Attachment: agenda_v1.pdf; hotel_block_confirmation.pdf
